# Empowering Aspirational India

> Empowering Aspirational India (EAI) is an initiative by K M Consulting focused on career advancement, social impact, job-ready skills programs, and professional doctoral pathways for learners and professionals in India.

Official website: https://www.eaiorg.in/

## Core Offer

EAI offers online, globally oriented education pathways for students, working professionals, mid-level professionals, and senior executives. The site presents job-ready skills programs awarded by State University of New York at Potsdam, USA, and experience-based European doctoral programs from The Thames International University, Paris, France.

## Job-Ready Skills Programs

The job-ready skills programs are offered in collaboration with National Education Foundation and State University of New York at Potsdam. They are described as industry-focused, online programs designed to support career advancement, higher education pathways, and professional growth.

- 3-Month Skill Certificate Programs: https://www.eaiorg.in/courses/skill-certificate/
- 6-Month Professional Diploma Programs: https://www.eaiorg.in/courses/professional-diploma/
- 12-Month Postgraduate Diploma Programs: https://www.eaiorg.in/courses/postgraduate-diploma/

Program facts:

- Awarded by: State University of New York at Potsdam, USA
- Recognition: UGC and AIU accredited in India
- Delivery: Online through Skillsoft LMS
- Certificate verification: SUNY Potsdam certificates include secure QR verification

## European Doctoral Programs

The doctoral programs are fully online, experience-based programs from The Thames International University, Paris, France. They are designed for working professionals and international learners seeking flexible academic advancement without career interruption.

- Doctor of Business Administration (DBA): https://www.eaiorg.in/doctoral-programs/dba/
- Doctor of Humanities (DHum): https://www.eaiorg.in/doctoral-programs/dhum/
- Doctor of Psychology (DPsych): https://www.eaiorg.in/doctoral-programs/dpsych/
- Doctor of Education (EdD): https://www.eaiorg.in/doctoral-programs/edd/
- Doctor of Applied Sciences (DAS): https://www.eaiorg.in/doctoral-programs/das/
- Doctor of Philosophy (Ph.D.) across multiple disciplines: https://www.eaiorg.in/doctoral-programs/phd/

Professional Doctorate note: The site states that a Professional Doctorate is awarded based on professional experience and requires a minimum of 15 years of work experience.
